info.name: OCI Control Center Capacity Management Demand Signal API

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The ocid of the compartment or tenancy in which resources are to be listed. This will also be used for authorization purposes.

params.name: name
params.description: A query parameter to filter the list of demand signal catalog resource based on the resource name.

params.name: demandSignalNamespace
params.description: A query parameter to filter the list of demand signal catalog resources based on the namespace.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: A token representing the position at which to start retrieving results. This must come from `opc-next-page` header field of a previous response.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort the response of List Demand catalog resources API. Only one sort order may be provided. The default order for name is case sensitive alphabetical order.

items.docs: This API will list all the  resources across all demand signal catalogs for a given namespace and customer group containing the caller compartment.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The ocid of the compartment or tenancy in which resources are to be listed. This will also be used for authorization purposes.

params.name: id
params.description: A query parameter to filter the list of demand signals based on it's OCID.

params.name: occmDemandSignalItemId
params.description: A query parameter to filter the list of demand signal items based on it's OCID.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: A token representing the position at which to start retrieving results. This must come from `opc-next-page` header field of a previous response.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort the response of List Demand Signal Delivery API. Only one sort order may be provided. The default order for resource name is case sensitive alphabetical order.

items.docs: This GET call is used to list all demand signals delivery resources within the compartment passed as a query param.

info.name: Get detailed information about resource demanded as part of the demand signal.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The ocid of the compartment or tenancy in which resources are to be listed. This will also be used for authorization purposes.

params.name: occmDemandSignalId
params.description: A query parameter to filter the list of demand signal items based on a demand signal id.

params.name: resourceName
params.description: A query parameter to filter the list of demand signal details based on the resource name.

params.name: demandSignalNamespace
params.description: A query parameter to filter the list of demand signal details based on the namespace.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: A token representing the position at which to start retrieving results. This must come from `opc-next-page` header field of a previous response.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort the response of List Demand Signal Details API. Only one sort order may be provided. The default order for resource name is case sensitive alphabetical order.

items.docs: This API will list the detailed information about the resources demanded as part of the demand signal.

info.name: A post call to create a demand signal item.

items.docs: This API will create a demand signal item representing a resource request. This needs to be grouped under a demand signal.

info.name: A post call to bulk create demand signal items.

items.docs: This API will help in bulk creation of demand signal items. This API is atomic i.e either all the demand signal item resources will be created or none will be created.

info.name: Get details about a particular demand signal item

params.name: occmDemandSignalItemId
params.description: The OCID of the demand signal item.

items.docs: This is a GET API to get the details of a demand signal item resource representing the details of the resource demanded by you.

info.name: Updates the occm demand signal item.

params.name: occmDemandSignalItemId
params.description: The OCID of the demand signal item.

items.docs: This is a PUT API which can be used to update the demand signal item resource.

info.name: Deletes the demand signal item resource.

params.name: occmDemandSignalItemId
params.description: The OCID of the demand signal item.

items.docs: This is a DELETE API which deletes a demand signal item with the provided demand signal item ocid.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The ocid of the compartment or tenancy in which resources are to be listed. This will also be used for authorization purposes.

params.name: id
params.description: A query parameter to filter the list of demand signals based on it's OCID.

params.name: lifecycleDetails
params.description: A query parameter to filter the list of demand signals based on its state.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only the resources that match the entire display name. The match is not case sensitive.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: A token representing the position at which to start retrieving results. This must come from `opc-next-page` header field of a previous response.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort the response of List Demand Signal API. Only one sort order may be provided. The default order for timeCreated is reverse chronological order (latest date at the top). The default order for displayName is case sensitive alphabetical order.

items.docs: This GET call is used to list all demand signals within the compartment passed as a query parameter.
